concepts.def: Free School Meals — sign of low income

walkthroughs.body_html:
In UK exams, pupils on Free School Meals (FSM) often score lower than others.

Boys vs girls, ethnic groups and regions also show gaps.

Why? Many reasons combined.

Possible causes:

  • Poverty — fewer books, no quiet study space.
  • Family stress.
  • Schools with fewer resources.
  • Low aspirations if no role models.

UK efforts to close gaps:

  • Pupil Premium — extra money per FSM child.
  • Free school meals at infant age.
  • Tutoring catch-up programmes.
  • Mentors and role models.

Long way to go. 🛣️

mcqs.q: What do interpretivists seek when researching society?
What is the difference between reliability and validity in research?
options: Reliable and valid mean the same thing — that the research is good.
Reliable research is published in journals; valid research isn't.
Reliability is whether a method produces consistent results when repeated; validity is whether it actually measures what it claims to. A method can be reliable but invalid, or valid but unreliable.

mcqs.q: What does Parsons mean by 'meritocracy' in education?
options: Rewards and roles are allocated based on individual achievement.
Reliable research is published in journals; valid research isn't.
Everyone gets equal outcomes regardless of effort.
